dedupe_keys.name: integrated time average shear wave velocity to a depth of 30 meters vs30 map of texas

description: Integrated Time Average Shear Wave Velocity to a Depth of 30 Meters (Vs30) Map of Texas is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). Vs30 is an important parameter used for characterizing site response in seismic analysis. With new measurements of Vs30 in Texas, we are able to create an integrated Vs30 map for Texas that is based on (1) available observations of Vs30 in Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas, (2) a geologic proxy for Vs30 based on rock type ... Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-wera-v784. Keywords: Map, Texas, Vs30, earthquake, geotechnical engineering, seismic. Published 2020-01-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
